title: 吸い殻専用の屋外処理スタンド
description: 建物外の喫煙場所向けの吸い殻専用スタンド。雨除け、開いた投入口、消火用格子、内箱、背面の点検扉と固定板を備えます。一般ごみ箱や消防設備ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.246 × 1.123 × 0.227 m、4,852三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A dedicated cigarette-waste pedestal for outdoor smoking areas, with a rain hood, open deposit mouth, crushing grate, inner receptacle, rear service door and anchor plate. It is not a general litter bin or fire-safety device. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.246 × 1.123 × 0.227 m; 4,852 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
